_note: A Baidu aerial of the twin runways is published; the other download was a low-resolution video frame with large burned-in text. The Esri World Imagery view is retained.

itm-baidu-1.webp.zh: 空中俯瞰大阪伊丹机场：平行的 14L/14R 跑道铺在平坦场地上，航站楼与机坪在其左侧，四周被密集的城市街区包围。
itm-baidu-1.webp.en: Aerial view of Osaka Itami — the parallel 14L/14R runways across a flat field, the terminal and apron to the left, with dense city blocks all around.

itm-sat-1.webp.zh: 从卫星图看，大阪伊丹国际机场（ITM）的机场布局与周边环境清晰可辨。
itm-sat-1.webp.en: In the satellite image, the layout of Osaka Itami International Airport (ITM) and its surroundings are clearly visible.
